description: Extension of the CronSettings class providing helper functions related to displaying and formatting cron job information, such as status tint colors, schedule summaries, duration formatting, and next run labels.

classes.name: CronSettings
classes.description: A class or struct managing cron job settings and related data.

methods.name: selectedJob
methods.description: Computed property returning the currently selected CronJob based on the stored selectedJobId.

methods.name: statusTint
methods.description: Returns a Color based on the string status, indicating success, error, skipped, or default.

methods.name: scheduleSummary
methods.description: Provides a human-readable summary of a CronSchedule, such as time or recurrence details.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration given in milliseconds into a concise string.

methods.name: nextRunLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label indicating when the next cron job is scheduled to run relative to now.
